series.label: smooth copper
series.notes: Gray filled-circle markers, isolated by RGB color mask (89,89,89) after tick calibration from axis labels 0/10/20/30/40 (x) and 0/20/40/.../140 (y). The last two interior points (~18.0, ~18.5 K) were partially occluded by the overlapping blue 'smooth PDMS' marker near CHF; centroids taken from the visible gray fragment. The grey X near the top is an extrapolation-arrow annotation, not a data point, and was excluded.

series.label: smooth PDMS
series.notes: Blue filled-circle markers (distinguished from the blue filled-square 'para PDMS' series by shape: fill-area/bounding-box ratio ~0.6-0.8 for circles vs ~1.0 for squares, after color-masking pure blue (0,0,255) and eroding away the thin dashed connector line). Two interior rungs (~x=14-16 K) are missing: at those points the smooth-copper gray marker is drawn on top and fully occludes the blue circle, so no reliable centroid could be extracted there; left out rather than fabricated. Excludes the small blue 'X' annotation mark near CHF, which is an arrow/extrapolation annotation, not a data point.

series.label: para PDMS
series.notes: Blue filled-square markers, isolated from the blue filled-circle 'smooth PDMS' series by shape (fill-area/bounding-box ratio ~1.0 for squares) after color masking and erosion to remove the dashed connector line. All 10 markers visible along this curve were cleanly resolved (no occlusion).

series.label: SHPho PDMS
series.notes: Red filled-triangle markers, isolated by color mask (255,0,0) and eroded to remove the dashed connector line; the similarly colored legend triangle icon and 'SHPho PDMS' legend text were excluded by position/size. Only 4 markers are present on this low, near-flat curve.
